name: Banff National Park
policyReason: Leashed dogs are welcome on most trails; a few trails are closed to dogs.
summary: Leashed dogs are welcome on most trails; a few trails are closed to dogs.

excerpts.quote: Dogs are not allowed on some trails
Pet owners must keep their dogs on leash at all times, except when in the Banff Off-Leash Dog Park or in fenced, private property.

dogRules.text: Dogs must be on leash everywhere except the Banff Off-Leash Dog Park.
Some trails are closed to dogs; check the Banff trails page and trailhead bulletins.
Never leave food dishes out, empty or full, especially at night.
Consider leaving your dog at home for camping, hiking or the backcountry.
